title: Verdant Ruins: The Machinist's Civic Seed
premise: In a forest city reclaimed by root-powered civic machines, the machinist must rebalance a failing mechanical relay using a portable phase regulator.
ending: Recover the Civic Seed and return with the stable field relay; Green Assembly can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive spore plume while evading the canopy defender without sacrificing the stable field relay.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Green Assembly to witness the portable phase regulator.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to divert power from a shelter
